Welcome to 744 W 20th Street, a beautifully renovated 1907 Craftsman in San Pedro’s Vista Del Oro neighborhoodthat pairs the character of an older home with the updates that make it easier to enjoy today. Set behind a white picket fence and mature hedging, this 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom home has been extensively improved with new electrical, plumbing, windows, lighting, fixtures, wall texture and flooring. Inside, natural light fills the open living and dining areas, where a fireplace adds warmth and character, while the updated kitchen, spacious bathroom and interior laundry make thoughtful use of the home’s 752 square feet. 
Outside is where the property really separates itself. The 5,007 square foot lot includes a large, private front yard designed for low maintenance living with artificial grass, decomposed granite and pavers throughout. Alley access at the rear provides substantial off street parking with room for multiple vehicles or an RV, along with RV connections already in place and a 120 square foot slab ready for a future shed or additional storage. A detached two car garage has been partially converted, and confirmed ADU potential gives the next owner additional flexibility for living space, a home office, guest accommodations or potential rental income. The roofs on both the home and detached garage were also replaced approximately three years ago.
The location puts you close to much of what makes living in San Pedro special, including being just six blocks from the marina, with Cabrillo Beach, Point Fermin Park, the Korean Bell of Friendship, the San Pedro waterfront and downtown San Pedro all nearby. Whether you’re heading toward the water or enjoying the privacy and low maintenance outdoor space at home, this is a property that offers considerably more than its footprint suggests.

The setting is calm and tucked away, with greenery and mountain views. Residents can enjoy the community's multiple pools and spas, along with the beautifully landscaped grounds. Downtown Palm Springs, dining, shopping, attractions, Palm Springs International Airport, and freeway access are just a few minutes away. Meaningful building updates were completed in 2026 by the HOA, including exterior paint and a new roof. These improvements enhance curb appeal and reduce near-term exterior maintenance concerns. The open-concept main floor is comfortable and easy to live in. The kitchen offers generous cabinet storage, a new dishwasher, and a counter bar for everyday meals or casual entertaining. Fresh interior paint gives the home a clean, move-in-ready feel. A recently installed HVAC (air/heat) system and water heater (May 2025) support year-round comfort and help reduce interior maintenance concerns. Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms have ample closets and large windows with desert views. A full bath upstairs and a half bath downstairs keep daily living convenient for owners and guests. Please note: Palm Springs Country Club is bordered by the former golf course, now being redeveloped as Serena Park with up to 300 residential units. Grading and construction are underway on the surrounding property. This condo can work as a full time home, seasonal retreat, or investment; buyers should independently weigh how nearby new construction may affect lifestyle, views, and future market comps.

remarks: Tall Pines, River, Solitude: Your Mountain Escape in Angelus Oaks. Located just steps away from the Santa Ana River, this fully furnished, turnkey mountain cabin is ready to enjoy in every season. This retreat sits in the heart of Angelus Oaks on U.S. Forest Service land under a special-use permit, surrounded by the San Gorgonio Wilderness and crisp mountain air. A 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom escape from the day-to-day noise of city life. Step inside to an open floor plan with exposed-beam ceilings, abundant natural light, and a cozywood-burning stove. Travertine flooring with a decorative mosaic medallion entry runs throughout, and the living room offers a built-in entertainment shelf, storage cabinet, and a sleeper sofa for extra guests. The upgraded kitchen is a true standout: granite countertops, rich wood cabinetry, soft-close drawers, and a farmhouse-style stainless sink set beneath windows with a peekaboo glimpse of the river. The updated bathroom continues the craftsmanship with a custom-tiled walk-in shower and natural stone finishes. Next, French glass doors open to a bedroom retreat wrapped in windows, warm wood paneling, unique architectural details, and a built-in closet. Imagine sipping your morning coffee on the front porch to the sound of the river, then unwinding on the spacious back patio as evening settles in under a sky of stars. The flat lot and ample parking make this cabin easy to enjoy. And once you're ready to explore beyond the porch, adventure is just outside your door. Nearby are Jenks Lake and miles of hiking and biking trails, with access to Big Bear and Bear Summit. This cabin offers a true escape from city noise, tucked into one of the San Bernardino Mountains' most peaceful recreational corridors. And when it's time to head into town, local charm is never far away. Grab a bite at The Oaks Restaurant or stock up at The Country Store, both just a short drive away; everything you need for a low-key mountain weekend is close at hand. This cabin is turnkey and ready, with every detail already in place: furniture, dcor, and comforts included, plus the practical essentials of electricity and a private water tank system, so you can settle in without a second thought. Just arrive, unpack, and start experiencing the mountain life. Sellers are highly motivated; bring your best cash offer.

remarks: An extraordinary opportunity to own one of Southern California's most unique legacy properties. Encompassing approximately 68 private acres in Los Angeles County, this remarkable estate offers an exceptional combination of history, infrastructure, privacy, and limitless potential. Bordering the Angeles National Forest and the San Gabriel Mountains to the south, the property enjoys an unparalleled setting of protected natural beauty, while panoramic views extend north toward Parker Mountain, creating breathtaking vistas in every direction. Along this particular stretch of Soledad Canyon, the canyon uniquely runs east to westan uncommon orientation in Southern California. This natural corridor allows cool ocean air to flow inland through the canyon, contributing to a refreshing microclimate and enhancing the property's year-round enjoyment. As the last privately owned property bordering the Angeles National Forest along this stretch of Soledad Canyon Road, there are no roads or easements crossing the property, preserving uninterrupted views, remarkable privacy, and an extraordinary sense of seclusion rarely found in Los Angeles County. The landscape is richly populated with mature palm trees, striking cactus varieties, native manzanita, chaparral, yucca, maguey, and other indigenous high desert vegetation, creating a dramatic and authentic California landscape. At the heart of the property lies a historic gold-bearing mine, adding a rare and authentic piece of California history to this extraordinary estate. The property has also served as the backdrop for major motion pictures, television productions, and national commercial campaigns, including Westworld, the feature film Mojave, Amazon commercial productions, and numerous other entertainment projects. An established road network, three dedicated parking areas, and extensive production infrastructure have successfully accommodated large-scale film productions. A location manager familiar with the property is available upon request. Significant capital improvements further distinguish this offering, including over $500,000 invested in electrical and utility infrastructure. The property features new utility poles, transformers, fire-protected electrical lines, a new permitted main electrical service, and electrical distribution throughout the ranch. A productive 138-foot private well supplies a 10,000-gallon epoxy-coated steel storage tank, with approximately one mile of buried 2-inch PVC water lines delivering water to the residence, barns, and all permitted structures throughout the property. Additional improvements include a commercial-sized 5,000-gallon septic system, upgraded copper water lines, insulated plumbing, new ABS waste lines, upgraded fencing and gates, and extensive structural enhancements. Multiple permitted buildings provide exceptional flexibility for restoration, renovation, or reimagining. Whether envisioned as a luxury estate, equestrian ranch, private retreat, family compound, premier filming location, wellness retreat, corporate getaway, or long-term investment, the possibilities are extraordinary. Buyer to verify with Los Angeles County all information, including future development or subdivision potential. With cinematic history, significant infrastructure, a historic gold-bearing mine, extraordinary privacy, protected natural surroundings, and some of the most spectacular panoramic views in Southern California, this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to own one of Los Angeles County's most remarkable legacy properties.

Welcome to Lakeside Resort, a private gated community, with it's own docks, clubhouse and beach, truly no other spot like it in Lake Arrowhead! Tucked down in the cove of Blue Jay Bay, this secluded neighborhood is what you have been searching for.
Have you dreamed of Lakeside living without the lakefront prices? Now is your opportunity. Located in the private enclave of Lakeside Resort Community, you’ll find this beautiful, furnished, all one level, 2023 built, three bedroom two bath modular home, just yards from the private beach and clubhouse! Upon arrival you will find 2 level parking spots and a near level entry with 4 steps to the front door. Once inside the light bright and well curated home will capture your heart. Inside you will find a primary ensuite bedroom, two additional bedrooms and a laundry area with washer and dryer, extra storage, and vaulted ceilings. Outside there are front and back Trex decking areas with ample outdoor living and dining space. In addition, there is an outdoor shed to store your lake and hiking gear. With 22 docks attached to Lakeside Resort you even have the opportunity to rent a slip and enjoy the water sports that Lake Arrowhead has to offer. Don’t pass this little gem up! Sellers are also selling their 2024 16 Suntracker Pontoon for extra $$$.

remarks: Tucked at the end of a long, private drive on 1.24 acres of mature landscape, this remarkable Mid-Century Modern residence by architect George Foy balances intimacy and openness in equal measure. Developed in 1958 by aviation pioneer Robert Bosler Sr., a friend of Amelia Earhart and colleague of Howard Hughes, the home reflects the optimism, innovation, and clean modernist sensibility of its era. As a playful expression of family life, Bosler designed the circular driveway so his young children could race go-karts around it, a distinctive feature that remains today. Thoughtfully positioned within its natural setting, the home is defined by Foy's signature post-and-beam construction, gracefully floating roof planes, and walls of glass all combining to create an extraordinary sense of lightness. Interior spaces, terraces, and mature gardens align to form seamless sightlines that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out, creating exceptional openness while preserving complete privacy. Comprehensively rebuilt and updated with the finest contemporary amenities, the residence remains true to Foy's original 1958 vision. Every enhancement honors the home's architectural integrity while elevating its comfort and livability for today. This is a rare opportunity to own an authentic George Foy designed residence, an enduring expression of California Mid-Century Modern architecture, thoughtfully reimagined for contemporary living while honoring its remarkable history and original vision. There is an additional benefit of a private nightly neighborhood patrol.

Located in desirable Montecito Heights, this custom-built 1998 residence offers approximately 2,300 square feet of generous living space, views of Downtown Los Angeles and Dodger Stadium, and exceptional flexibility for today’s homeowner. One APN with three separate addresses of 598, 600, and 600 1/2 Montecito. With five bedrooms and three bathrooms overall—including a four-bedroom, two-bath main residence and an attached permitted one-bedroom, one-bath Jr. ADU—the property is well suited for growing families, multigenerational living, extended family, guests, or supplemental rental income.  Originally constructed as a five-bedroom, three-bath home, one of the larger bedrooms and one bathroom were later converted into the Jr. ADU. The main residence continues to offer four well-sized bedrooms, including a particularly spacious bedroom on the entry level and three additional comfortable bedrooms. The generous room sizes provide living space that can be difficult to find in many newer homes.
The attached Jr. ADU offers a level of independence that distinguishes it from many similar properties. It has its own address, separate entrance, and separate water and electrical meters, allowing the homeowner and occupant to manage their utilities independently without estimating or dividing usage. This makes the space especially practical for aging parents, adult children, a live-in caregiver, long-term guests, or a tenant.
The home retains much of its original 1998 character and offers the next owner an opportunity to update the finishes gradually according to their own taste and budget. Its substantial living space, large bedrooms, views, and permitted Jr. ADU can be enjoyed while improvements are completed over time.  The unfinished additional lower-level space with separate exterior access, address, and utilities, provides further possibilities for future customization or expansion, subject to buyer investigation and applicable approvals. Construction was halted several years ago due to the owner's passing, and the space is in various stages of approvals with the City.  
Whether envisioned as a spacious primary residence, a multigenerational home, or a property offering both personal use and supplemental income, this Montecito Heights home presents a unique opportunity to create something special while benefiting from the space and flexibility already in place.
Property is ideal for BOTH a flipper as well as owner-occupier. Won't last long!

remarks: Tucked behind an electric-gated entrance on 3.55 acres with no HOA, this beautifully upgraded custom single-level home offers a rare combination of privacy, space, thoughtful design, and true move-in-ready living in Valley Center. Offering approximately 2,040 square feet with 3 bedrooms and 2.5  bathrooms, the home has been thoughtfully improved with exceptional attention to detail. From the moment you arrive along the tree-lined drive, it is clear this is a special property. Inside, soaring 10-foot ceilings and an open-concept design create a bright and spacious feel. The beautifully remodeled kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring a large built-in quartz island and an easy connection to the main living and entertaining spaces. Tile flooring, a wood-burning stove, and carefully selected finishes add warmth and character throughout. Designed to embrace the Southern California lifestyle, the home offers wonderful indoor-outdoor living with custom covered patios, a secluded courtyard ideal for entertaining, low-maintenance mature landscaping, and peaceful views that enhance the property’s sense of privacy and seclusion. Located on the western side of Valley Center, the property offers an exceptionally quiet and peaceful setting and can enjoy refreshing ocean breezes. Outside is where the possibilities really expand. With 3.55 acres, abundant parking, room for RVs and larger vehicles, extensive fencing, a large storage shed, and agricultural potential, the property offers tremendous flexibility. In addition to the main gated entrance, a secondary dual-gated entrance at the lower portion of the property provides additional access and space for extended parking, RVs, or potential future uses such as a workshop or ADU, subject to applicable approvals. An RV pump-out is already on site. The backyard is separately enclosed, providing an additional space for pets, play, or outdoor enjoyment. Additional features include natural gas rather than propane, a 2-inch water meter, and a septic system that has been pumped and certified. The scenic drive through western Valley Center passes the historic Pala Rey Ranch, with its cattle, lake, and year-round stream. While the property feels remarkably peaceful and private, it is approximately 15 minutes from I-15, with shopping, dining, boutique wineries, and other North County amenities within easy reach. Beautifully maintained, thoughtfully upgraded, and surrounded by 3.55 acres of space and privacy, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy the Valley Center lifestyle without sacrificing comfort, quality, or convenience.

remarks: A cinematic interplay of architecture, landscape, and light defines this South Palm Springs estate that reimagines modern desert luxury. Nestled in the exclusive Andreas Hills enclave, the residence offers a rare harmony of artistry, comfort, and absolute privacy. Originally envisioned by the acclaimed firm Tichenor & Thorp, this Moorish-inspired masterpiece has been thoughtfully reimagined for contemporary living. Spanning nearly one third of an acre, the estate features 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, and over 4,800 square feet of refined living space including a private guest house and exceptional bedroom separation for privacy and flow. Every detail reflects the designers' celebrated eye for form, proportion, and garden composition. Grand scale meets serene restraint with high ceilings, tall Venetian plaster walls, and graceful arched passageways that frame curated views of courtyards and lush gardens. Carrara marble surfaces, broad skylights, and French doors bring balance and light, while the formal living room's commanding fireplace provides a striking architectural centerpiece. The chef's kitchen is both functional and inviting, blending custom cabinetry, an oversized marble island, and generous workspace that opens seamlessly to the family room. Designed for connection, it accommodates everything from morning coffee to large scale entertaining with effortless sophistication. Outdoors, the home's series of covered and open air patios dissolve boundaries between structure and nature. A fireplace warmed loggia, alfresco dining area, and intimate garden vignettes encourage lingering under the desert sky. Mature 100 year old olive trees, towering date palms, and lush layered plantings form a tranquil backdrop to the dramatic pool and secluded spa, enhanced by outdoor showers and complete privacy. With owned solar, a gated motor court, and every modern refinement, this Andreas Hills estate is both a timeless architectural statement and a deeply livable sanctuary, a rare composition of light, texture, and soul.

remarks: A dual-entry motor court paved in stone sets the stage for arrival, framed by a striking wood-slatted facade and seamless glass balconies that lend the residence its warm modern presence. The approach unfolds with quiet confidence, introducing interiors defined by grand proportions, plastered walls, and meticulously crafted millwork that carries continuity throughout the home. Inside, the main level reveals a sequence of expansive gathering spaces designed for both scale and intimacy. A formal living room wrapped entirely in floor-to-ceiling glass draws natural light deep into the home, while the adjacent dining room connects discreetly to the chef's kitchen. Here, bespoke stone walls and countertops meet custom oak cabinetry, anchored by two dramatic waterfall islands that serve as both workspace and social centerpiece. Wolf, Miele, and Sub-Zero appliances integrate seamlessly within the design, while a casual dining area sits just beyond. The kitchen transitions effortlessly into a generous family room centered around a ribbed-detail fireplace, with towering pocket glass doors dissolving the boundary between interior living and the surrounding grounds. A sculptural staircase  elegantly curved and extending across three floors  acts as a visual anchor, its glass ceiling above filtering daylight downward, while an elevator provides effortless access to every level. Above, a library-style lounge at the landing connects the primary suite with three additional bedroom suites, each offering walk-in closets and beautifully appointed baths, with the largest featuring a private patio overlooking Alpine. The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with a ribbed fireplace and a covered wraparound terrace. Its boutique-style dressing room leads to a marble bathroom with dual vanities, soaking tub, and oversized rainfall shower, where glass walls open directly to the terrace and backyard beyond. The lower level unfolds around a dramatic double-height glass courtyard, where a living olive tree rises beside a vertical green wall to create a serene natural centerpiece. Arranged around this space are a series of gathering and lifestyle areas including a large lounge with billiards, a marble bar with dual wine refrigerators, and a dedicated theater. A private office and library open to their own patio for quiet work or reading, while wellness amenities include a fitness studio, sauna, and steam room. This floor also accommodates a guest bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite bath sharing the library patio, along with a laundry room and three full bathrooms. Outdoors, a long covered patio with integrated heating and an outdoor kitchen anchors the grounds, complemented by a pool, spa, outdoor shower, and multiple lounge areas designed for relaxed entertaining. Located within the Beverly Hills Flats, the residence places the city's most celebrated shopping, dining, and cultural destinations just minutes away, along with access to top-rated schools and community amenities.

remarks: What if you could live in the heart of Echo Park and still feel tucked away from it all? Bright, airy, and centered around sweeping views of the lake and park, this two-level condo offers that rare balance: the creative energy of the Eastside just outside your door and a calm, sunlit oasis waiting when you come home. Designed in 1973 by noted Los Angeles architect Allyn E. Morris, Lago Vista takes full advantage of its hillside setting and connection to the landscape. The home's two-level layout, white-painted exposed beams, and broad expanses of glass carry that modernist sensibility throughout. The main level is open and inviting, with an updated kitchen and comfortable living and dining spaces that lead to a large private balcony. Blonde wood flooring flows through the living areas and bedrooms, bringing continuity to the home's fresh, understated palette. The balcony is an ideal spot for morning coffee, dinner with friends, or simply watching the light shift across the lake and surrounding hills. Upstairs, two bedrooms offer even more natural light, with a wide panoramic window framing a remarkable, straight-on view of Echo Park Lake, its fountain, palm trees, and the park beyond. The bathroom retains its original cobalt blue tiles and features a skylight that brings in natural light. Central heating and air conditioning provide year-round comfort. The unit comes with its own tandem parking for two cars within the gated property. Lush, well-maintained grounds and the complex's distinctive teardrop-shaped pool complete the sense of retreat. And, when you're ready to rejoin the city, Echo Park Lake and its swan boats are just footsteps away, while the Echoplex, Bar Flores, Donna's, and other restaurants, shops, and nightlife along Sunset are all in your backyard. It's a low-key, stylish retreat in the middle of Echo Park, truly one of LA's coolest neighborhoods.

remarks: Set behind the prestigious gates of Fairbanks Ranch, this extraordinary contemporary estate is a true architectural statement—where modern design, natural beauty, and absolute privacy converge on a scale rarely found in coastal North County.  Privately positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on over 8.6 acres, the property captures sweeping, unobstructed views across the San Dieguito River Valley—offering a sense of serenity and openness that feels worlds away, yet remains just minutes from Rancho Santa Fe and Del Mar.  The 12,745-square-foot residence showcases striking contemporary architecture defined by clean lines, dramatic volumes, and walls of glass that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. Designed to embrace its surroundings, the home is filled with natural light, with expansive floor-to-ceiling doors and open-concept living spaces that create a seamless, effortless flow throughout. Sophisticated materials, including curated marble and granite finishes, add warmth and refinement to the modern aesthetic.  Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and grand-scale entertaining, the home features six spacious bedrooms, a luxurious primary retreat with spa-inspired bath and steam shower, dual executive offices, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with commercial-grade appliances and an oversized walk-in pantry. A full suite of resort-caliber amenities elevates the experience—highlighted by a 14-seat theater, indoor fitness pool with endless current, indoor spa, wine cellar, art studio, and a dramatic 1,000-gallon aquarium that serves as a living work of art.  The outdoor environment rivals a private resort. An infinity-edge pool and spa anchor the grounds, complemented by expansive view decks, an indoor-outdoor cabana, multiple entertaining areas with BBQs and fire features, a putting green, bocce court, and a mature fruit orchard. With ample space and zoning for horses—an uncommon offering within Fairbanks Ranch—the estate delivers both luxury and versatility.  Complete with smart-home integration, solar energy system, and a four-car garage, the property also offers convenient access to Fairbanks Ranch’s premier amenities, including the lake, clubhouse, tennis and pickleball courts, and scenic walking trails.  This is a rare opportunity to own one of Fairbanks Ranch’s most architecturally significant contemporary estates—where privacy, design, and lifestyle align in a truly unforgettable setting.

remarks:
Welcome to your family’s next chapter in the established and welcoming neighborhood of Century Hill. Built in 1979, this spacious two-story, 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home sits on over half an acre, offering a wonderful, functional layout for a vibrant family lifestyle rich in neighborhood community spirit and quality local schools. It is the kind of neighborhood where kids ride bikes together and families look out for one another. The highly adaptable floor plan is perfectly tailored for growing families or multi-generational living, featuring a convenient lower-level bedroom and full bathroom that is ideal for visiting grandparents, a teenager's retreat, or a home office.

The heart of the daily routine centers around the massive family room, where a cozy fireplace serves as the perfect backdrop for family game nights, movie marathons, and rainy afternoons. Right next door, the classic kitchen is well-equipped for busy mornings with durable tile flooring, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances that effortlessly handle everyday family life. Upstairs, the primary suite and three additional bedrooms keep the kids close by on the same level. The upper level also boasts an expansive outdoor deck, offering a wonderful, elevated vantage point to keep an eye on the kids playing below or to enjoy a quiet morning coffee.

The true magic of this property unfolds in the massive backyard, which serves as a private, everyday vacation zone for children and a haven for relaxed family living. Beat the summer heat in the larger-than-typical pool and spa, designed for epic splash contests, weekend pool parties, and relaxing soak sessions after a long day. An expansive lawn invites games of tag, while the private sport court stands ready for shooting hoops and neighborhood games. When the sun begins to set, you can fire up the grill for quiet evening BBQs under the extensive covered patio, kept cool by ceiling fans while overlooking the mature trees and shade.

Practical features abound with two large storage sheds to keep outdoor toys and sports gear neatly tucked away, plus dedicated RV parking for your family road-trip adventures. While you will feel a world away in this quiet suburban retreat, you are just minutes from downtown Riverside and the historic Mission Inn, packed with kid-friendly restaurants, community events, and seasonal festivals. With seamless access to multiple freeways, your daily school runs and commutes are completely effortless.

remarks: Have you ever wanted to own an estate legacy style property? Welcome to Reyes vineyard and winery, located in the beautiful heart of Aqua Dulce, California. Aqua Dulce, which translates to ‘sweet water’ in Spanish, is known for it’s tranquil, rural lifestyle. Noted for it’s beautiful sunrises and sunsets, Vasquez Rocks is a popular destination for hiking and filmmaking, and is just a short distance away. The property has expanded over the years with the purchase of additional acreage, now 20.54 flat usable acres. Sierra Hwy frontage!! 2 high producing water wells. 80,000 gallons of above ground water storage. Miles of irrigation. Main house , completely rebuilt in 2005 is a stunning 2 story with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with a rare find. A small cellar.  2 additional bathrooms are in the tasting room and winery. Not interested in a winery? The wine making building would make a perfect 6 car garage with high ceilings for double stacking your prized show cars. The tasting room could easily be converted to a large party area with bar and commercial style cooking area for events and parties. Circular paved front grand entrance.  Abundant parking. Forever views. So many possibilities. This property offers endless, unique opportunities for you to plan your next celebration, be it a private party, a wedding or even a corporate event.  Aqua Dulce is located northeast of the Santa Clarita Valley, only 45 minutes North of DTLA and is designated as a Los Angeles Winery within the Sierra Pelona Valley Appellation. Over the past several years, the wines of Reyes Winery have won over 350 medals and awards. Come for a visit, Stay for a lifetime, Welcome Home!

remarks: A true sanctuary in every sense, this one-of-a-kind trophy estate by the late, legendary architect Howard Backen sits on the 7th hole of the iconic Riviera Country Club - the only Backen-designed home ever built on L.A.'s premier golf course. The location is unparalleled: discreetly positioned next to Channel Road, it offers quick access to the beaches, Malibu, the Brentwood Country Mart, and some of the finest dining - all while feeling worlds away from it all. Welcome to ground zero for luxury, privacy, and sophisticated Zen living.

remarks: Impeccably situated on over four acres in ultra-prime lower Bel Air, Villa Cresta stands as an unparalleled Tuscan estate blending majestic city and ocean views, sprawling idyllic grounds, and timeless architecture by renowned Marc Appleton, AIA. The journey begins at the stately front gates, where a dramatic waterfall welcomes guests as they proceed up a cypress-lined driveway, past a lush olive tree grove, to an expansive gravel motor court. Generous parking accommodates 25+ vehicles. Framed by two majestic cork oaks at the main entry, the home's grand spaces immediately showcase an extraordinary level of craftsmanship and detail. Serving as an impressive anchor for the residence, the main hallway is finished in exquisite Venetian plaster and leads to a capacious living room featuring a 16th-century stone mantel fireplace. This space connects seamlessly to a sophisticated library adorned in beautiful woodwork under blue and yellow glazed ceramic ceiling tiles; together, these principal rooms flow effortlessly out to a spectacular, long vaulted loggia, sprawling lawn, sparkling infinity-edge pool, and endless panoramas. The light-filled kitchen is rustic yet refined, complete with a large center island, ample storage, and a built-in breakfast nook with its own dedicated fireplace. Nearby, wood-beamed ceilings and an 18th-century stone mantel fireplace adorn the formal dining room, which comfortably accommodates large-scale dinner parties. For private quarters, the main level primary suite serves as the ultimate sanctuary, featuring dual bathrooms, exceptional closet space, an integrated home office, a private study, and a dedicated garden with sweeping city-to-ocean views and a hot tub. The main residence offers four additional well-appointed bedrooms, complemented by a separate, spacious detached guest house ideal for long-term visitors. On the versatile lower level, the estate features an exercise room, a generous space designated for a future state-of-the-art home theater, a transportive 1920's prohibition-style disco, and a wine cellar that offers both exceptional bottle storage and a dramatic setting for tastings, dinners, and intimate entertaining. Completing the estate's romantic, old-world charm, the private hillside vineyard actively produces Sangiovese grapes, offering an estate-grown vintage in one of Los Angeles' most exclusive enclaves. Truly a definitive legacy property, Villa Cresta awaits its next chapter.

remarks: This STUNNING Downtown Los Angeles (DTLA) corner loft is available for immediate occupancy! It features 9ft tall ceilings, exposed brick, massive operable windows, cross- ventilation, and dramatic views of the world-famous Bradbury Building and the beautiful DTLA skyline. It must be seen in-person to be appreciated. This wonderful loft features: an historic entry door; historic tile and wood floors; a dramatic foyer and entry gallery; very large and open, loft-style living, dining and kitchen areas; Poggenpohl kitchen cabinets and countertops; Bosch appliances, including a gas stovetop; a stackable washer and dryer; a Waterworks bathroom, including a large, deep, soaking bathtub; a large, separate private bedroom with a door for privacy; custom window coverings; and a recently replaced HVAC system, and new electrical breaker box. The Douglas Building (DB), located at the northwest corner of S Spring and W 3rd Streets in Downtown Los Angeles (DTLA), was completed in 1899 as an office building by the estate of Thomas Douglas Stimson, and is one of the most sought-after adaptive re-use addresses in the Central City. In 2005, the developer took great care to utilize as much historic fabric as possible, but the lofts themselves, including all utilities, were new construction. Designed by Reid Brothers Architects in the "Classic Revival Style," and located just two blocks south of Los Angeles City Hall, and one block from the iconic Grand Central Market (GCM), the DB benefits from The Mills Act, which significantly reduces the property taxes for the buyer. The DB is a dog (and cat!) loving building, has a doggy potty area, and the Police Headquarters "dog park" lawn is only a block away at S Spring and W 2nd Streets. The Historic Broadway subway station is located on the same block as the DB, at the southeast corner of S Broadway and W 2nd St. Although the DB has no on-site building amenities, DTLA itself is the amenity, including the GCM, Grand Park, the Music Center, which includes the Walt Disney Concert Hall, The Broad Museum and many restaurants and bars within easy walking distance. We hope you'll come to see Unit 2M soon!

remarks: Built in 1937, 811 Thayer Avenue sits on one of Little Holmby's most special streets, part of the original enclave designed and developed in this early era of the neighborhood. This heritage home keeps the character and pedigree of that period fully intact. From the street, the home greets you with board-and-batten siding, dentil-trimmed eaves, navy shutters, a direct-access two-car garage, and a mature tree canopy, the kind of craftsmanship rarely done today, as the artistry and labor have become cost prohibitive. Inside, high ceilings run throughout. The formal living room is the showpiece: a detailed, hand-carved mantel frames the fireplace, crown moulding traces the ceiling line, and a bay window with a cozy bench fills the room with natural light. The connected family room, wrapped in rich wood paneling, brings warmth and depth throughout, a beautiful counterpoint to the more formal spaces, and a wonderful setting for an office, den, or library. A large kitchen with stainless steel countertops and a charming bay window is joined by an exceptionally large laundry room, which could be partially repurposed. The butler's kitchen and breakfast room add beautiful detail, with warm wood countertops and cabinets framed by architectural arches, leading into the adjoining dining room, which continues the classic story with plantation shutters, a statement chandelier, and warm flooring underfoot. A bedroom and bathroom downstairs offers flexibility for an office, guests or multigenerational living. Upstairs, two bedrooms and two bathrooms are joined by an office, likely a former sleeping porch, a charming, light-filled bonus room with great city views and a spacious closet, potentially reimagined as a fourth bedroom. The home has been lovingly maintained over the years and is now ready for its next chapter, while preserving the master craftsmanship and character that define it. Outside, a private brick patio wrapped in mature greenery adds a wonderful indoor-outdoor feel, complete with a hot tub and seating. The charming side yards offer sitting areas and room for a workshop, art area, or garden boxes to grow your own vegetables. This is a floor plan with great bones, distinct, purposeful rooms, on one of Little Holmby's most coveted streets, offering a rare opportunity to restore a heritage classic to its full glory. remarks: Authentic 1928 Spanish in Lake Hollywood Knolls, where silent film star Harry Langdon pressed his name and his handprint into the wet concrete steps on November 25, 1933, beside a carved beer stein, ten days before Prohibition ended. The signatures are still there. Set behind a walled and gated brick courtyard, mature olive trees and bougainvillea climbing an arched entry to a carved wood door set with stained glass, the home sits between the energy of Hollywood and the neighborhood charm of Studio City, private and quiet behind dual-pane windows. Inside, the living room stretches beneath dark exposed beams, anchored by a sculpted corner fireplace and a deep arched bookshelf set into the plaster. A pair of doors opens it into the sun room, vaulted and wrapped in windows on two walls, flexible as a study, a studio or a place for visiting family, with its own door to the private balcony and the primary bedroom beyond. The dining room sits between arched openings and built-in niches, stepping down to a generous kitchen in white cabinetry and quartz on terra cotta tile. Two bedrooms and two baths complete the level. Two spaces handle the entertaining: the private front courtyard for morning coffee and evening cocktails, and an expansive lower terrace walled by a mature ficus hedge and strung with cafe lights, where the owners have hosted gatherings of up to sixty guests. A Hollywood Sign trail entrance sits at the end of the street. The attached garage is currently a finished executive office, easily returned to parking. At the foot of those 1933 steps is the Frida Apartment, named by the owners for Frida Kahlo and furnished in her spirit, with a small portrait of the artist in the bath. A complete private guest suite with its own entrance, family room, kitchen, bath, walk-in closet and a bedroom larger than either upstairs, it conveys furnished. City-approved JADU plans convey with the covenant already recorded, a path chosen deliberately because it preserves short-term rental use. As a short-term rental it has averaged approximately $3,500 per month for the current owners. Timeless character and modern flexibility in the heart of the Hollywood Hills. Some houses have history. This one has it signed and dated.

remarks:
The impeccably maintained historic Logsdon estate, where memories of four generations have been made, is available for sale and on the market for
the first time ever! This 3 bedroom 2 bathroom full time cabin offers an abundance of mountain charm, modern updates and a functional floor plan that
is sure to please. Originally constructed in 1932 by master craftsmen, the house is on an elevated corner lot perfectly situated to offer easy walking options to the lake and quaint village, views of the mountains, and a park like setting that offers peace and tranquility. Inside, the large custom front door provides a grand entry to a large living room with a native rock fireplace. Knotty pine tongue and groove material adorns the walls in authentic mountain style. The large country kitchen is fully equipped with dishwasher, gas range, and ample counter space for holiday meals or just the weekend round of flapjacks. The kitchen also includes a functional antique cast iron cook stove. The indoor laundry is conveniently located around the corner, along with main floor bedroom and remodeled bathroom, bringing form and function together seamlessly. The newly-remodeled bathroom features a glass enclosed shower and hand made Moroccan Zellige tile. All interior doors have been button built and offer excellent craftsmanship. Upstairs, the wide staircase and landing lead to two more bedrooms, each with plenty of room and offering tree top views of the natural Jeffrey and Ponderosa pines. Upstairs is also where you will find the second bathroom, with the highlight being the majestic claw foot soaking tub and new vinyl plank flooring. Other modern updates in the house include dual pane windows, forced air central heat, and alarm system. Outside, the sturdy covered front porch with native log support beams is your zen zone and a perfect opportunity to relax and watch the birds and squirrels, all while enjoying the four seasons. The side patio area offers fenced garden beds and access to the many fruit trees, lilacs and other plants that adorn the garden. The landscaping is watered with a full system of automatic sprinklers. Down in the garage is a soft water system and forced air furnace. This once in a lifetime opportunity will not last long, so come take a look before it is locked up by another family for another 100 years!!

Completely renovated, the interiors feature a clean, modern aesthetic with warm natural materials. Upstairs, the rooftop deck captures 360-degree unobstructed views from the Santa Monica Pier to Palos Verdes and Catalina Island, extending to the whitewater at Point Dume. Downstairs, the primary suite offers a private ocean-view retreat with a lounge area, motorized drop-down television, walk-in closet, and a spa-like bath with a free-standing porcelain soaking tub and dual rain steam shower. Two additional en-suite bedrooms and a separate one-bedroom, one-bath guest suite provide flexibility for guests, a workspace, or creative use. A generous grassy lawn wraps the home, with plans available for a pool. Additional features include a full-home Sonos system, remote-controlled blackout shades, two-car garage, driveway parking, and a laundry room. This is a coveted opportunity to own one of Malibu's most recognizable architectural properties - move-in ready and available fully furnished.

remarks: A Rare Canyon Retreat, Offered for the First Time in Over 50 Years!  Tucked into a peaceful canyon setting, this private and distinctive home tells the story of another era built with love, and rich with authentic Kensington character. Its mid-century flair meets the open, airy design influences of the 1970s, creating a layout that feels both grounded and free. Behind the home's bones stands Verner & Miram, a San Francisco structural engineering firm whose name carried real weight in mid-century California architecture. Partners Edwin A. Verner and Oleg V. Miram built their reputation from the 1940s through the 1960s, becoming the engineers architects turned to when a project demanded more than the ordinary. Their fingerprint here is part of what makes this home more than a relic of its era it's a piece of art! its open-concept flow to the quiet sense of privacy and retreat that defines the property. Filled with personality and possibility, this is a true canvas a rare opportunity for a buyer with vision to honor the home's original character while reimagining it for the way we live today. Homes like this seldom come to market. For the right owner, it's a chance to create something entirely their own, in a setting that feels worlds away, yet close to everything.

remarks: There are neighborhoods that simply feel good to come home to. Upper Broadmoor is one of them—tree-lined streets, distinctive 1920s architecture, and a strong sense of community.  Tucked into this picturesque setting, 592 Lewis Avenue is a charming 1927 home where period character meets thoughtful updates. Hardwood floors, crown molding, paneled walls, built-ins, and a classic fireplace give the living spaces warmth and personality, while the refreshed kitchen, updated bath, and two comfortable bedrooms bring a clean, contemporary sensibility.  A covered front porch welcomes you home, while private, fenced outdoor spaces create room for morning coffee, an afternoon read, or dinner al fresco. Recent improvements include interior paint and lighting, refreshed kitchen cabinetry, updated fixtures, new fencing, rockscaping, and improvements to the home's laundry and utility spaces.  Then comes the unexpected bonus: an approximately 780-square-foot attic with finished flooring, windows, and generous open space. The attic is permitted for storage, with new drop-down stairs providing convenient access—an abundance of useful space tucked above the main living spaces.  The attached garage has also been restored to its intended use as a garage, while the recently completed permit work includes relocation of the washer and dryer and their hookups to the existing covered side porch, a new gas line, a new side-porch door, and the permitted drop-down attic stairs. The permit has been finaled, providing added confidence in the completed work.  Close to Chabot Regional Park, Farrelly Pool, Roosevelt Elementary, and a lively mix of cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and neighborhood shops, 592 Lewis offers something increasingly difficult to find: a home with character in one of San Leandro's most distinctive neighborhoods.
